items.why: Real charities handle mistakes properly.

items.text: 'Everyone on TikTok is buying, don't miss out!'
items.why: Fear of missing out (FOMO) is hype, not analysis.

items.text: Bonds pay less than stocks on average but are steadier
items.why: Lower risk, lower expected return, a fair trade-off.

items.text: 'This coin will 100× by Friday, my cousin said so'
items.why: Rumors and precise wild predictions are red flags.

items.text: Investing a bit every month for many years
items.why: Dollar-cost averaging over time is a sound habit.

items.text: 'Act now, only 3 spots left in this secret fund!'
items.why: Scarcity pressure and secrecy are classic scam tactics.

items.text: Spreading money across many companies to lower risk
items.why: Diversification is basic, reasonable investing.

items.text: 'Borrow money to buy more, prices only go up!'
items.why: Prices don't only go up. Borrowing to invest magnifies losses.

items.text: A company's earnings grew, so its stock rose over several years
items.why: Prices following real profits over time is reasonable.

items.text: A savings account paying 4% with government insurance
items.why: Insured savings at market rates is reasonable.

items.text: "Turn $100 into $10,000 with my secret system, only 3 spots left"
items.why: Secret systems and fake scarcity are hype.

items.text: Stocks can fall 30% in a bad year but have grown over long periods
items.why: Honest about risk and time, reasonable.

items.text: "This AI bot trades for you and never loses"
items.why: Every real strategy loses sometimes.

items.text: Paying off a 24% credit card is like earning 24% risk-free
items.why: Clearing high-interest debt is a reasonable, certain return.
Celebrity endorsements are often paid promotions.

items.text: Diversifying across hundreds of companies lowers your risk
items.why: Spreading money out is a sound principle.

items.text: "Quit your job: I made $40,000 last month day trading"
items.why: Screenshots of one great month prove nothing.

items.text: Higher potential returns usually come with higher risk
items.why: Risk and return travel together.

items.text: "Banks don't want you to know this one trick"

items.text: A fund that charges 0.05% a year and tracks the whole market
items.why: Low-cost index funds are a reasonable choice.

items.text: "Double your money in 30 days, guaranteed by our partners"
items.why: Guaranteed doubling is a sign of fraud.

items.text: Starting to invest early gives compounding more time
items.why: Time is a reasonable, proven advantage.

items.text: "Everyone in the group chat made 300%, you're missing out"
items.why: FOMO from a group chat is not research.

items.text: Bonds usually fall in value when interest rates rise
items.why: An honest, well-known relationship.

items.text: "Join now and earn by recruiting friends who also join"
items.why: Recruit-to-earn is how pyramid schemes work.

items.text: Keeping three to six months of costs in savings before investing
items.why: A sound, reasonable foundation.

items.text: "This penny stock is the next big tech giant, insiders confirm"
items.why: Unnamed insiders and wild comparisons are hype.

items.text: Past performance does not guarantee future results
items.why: An honest warning every investor should know.

items.text: "Send 1 coin, get 2 back from our official giveaway"
items.why: Send-to-receive giveaways are always scams.

items.text: Rebalancing once a year to keep your planned mix
items.why: A reasonable, disciplined habit.

items.text: "Forex robot with a 98% win rate for just $499"
items.why: If it worked, it would not be for sale.

items.text: An employer retirement match is free money up to the limit
items.why: Accurate and reasonable.

items.text: "Real estate course: get rich with zero money down, starting tomorrow"
items.why: No-money-down get-rich courses are hype.

items.text: Index funds rarely beat the market because they are the market
items.why: An honest description.

items.text: "The market will crash tomorrow, sell everything now"
items.why: Nobody can time crashes to the day.

items.text: A high-yield savings account for money you need within a year
items.why: Safe money for short-term goals is reasonable.

items.text: "My friend's startup is guaranteed to be the next unicorn"
items.why: No startup is guaranteed.

items.text: Fees of 1% a year can add up to a large share of returns over decades
items.why: True and reasonable to consider.

items.text: "Limited-time NFT drop, prices only go up"
items.why: "Only go up" is never true.
